evals.prompt: /factory:install acme/widgets. Answer the questions with the recommended answers. When asked to apply the plan, answer no.
evals.expected_output: The command checks gh auth, shows the full plan, asks once for consent, receives no, and stops. Nothing is created or changed.
expectations: AC2: the plan lists the Project, the stage options, the BLOCKED and REVIEW labels, factory.yml and the .tmp/* line before any change
AC2: the command asks for consent once
AC2: after the answer no, no gh project create, gh label create, gh issue create or file write runs
AC2: the command does not edit .claude/settings.json

evals.prompt: /factory:install acme/widgets on a repo where the Project, the labels, factory.yml and the .tmp/* line already exist. Answer yes to apply.
evals.expected_output: The plan marks every item as no change. The command changes nothing. The dummy card test still runs and cleans up after itself.
expectations: AC4: every plan item is marked as already present or no change
AC4: no second Project is created
AC4: .gitignore holds one .tmp/* line, not two
